fusions.name: Strike from Coil
fusions.desc: A sudden strike that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Venom Reckoning
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health for 14 damage, consuming every affliction on it for 1.8 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Warm Side Forward
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded water snake that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.6 seconds within 5 tiles. It leaves [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
